☁️ Google Drive backup

Har order apne aap is browser me save hota hai. Drive ON karne par wahi data aapke Google Drive me bhi backup hoga — kisi bhi device par restore kar sakte ho. Data JSON + Excel dono format me jaata hai.

Not connected
ℹ️ Drive setup (ek hi baar, 2 min)

1. console.cloud.google.com → new project → APIs & Services → Library me Google Drive API enable karo.
2. OAuth consent screen banao → Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → type Web application.
3. "Authorized JavaScript origins" me jis website/URL se app khulega wo daalo (jaise https://yourname.github.io).
4. Bana hua Client ID upar wale box me paste karo → Connect Drive.
Note: Drive sirf https website se chalega (file:// se nahi). Bina Drive ke bhi sab kuch local me safe rehta hai.

🧾 Bill Settings (Logo, Name, Address, Notes — sab yahan set karo)
